Justice is coming to all of us. No matter what we do.

Harold Crick isn't ready to go. Period.

No Fear. No Limits. No Brakes. Just Ducks.

If the signal dies so does she.

Be careful what you wish for.

It Is Nowhere Written That The American Empire Goes On Forever
Self - Advisor, U.S. Dept. of Defense
Self - Project for the New American Century

The Man. The Legend. The King of Rock & Roll.

Life is original. Everything else is copy.

A woman without shame. A woman without soul.

A soul wandering in love… Belladonna, a flower that blooms with the sap of tears…

When the darkness falls the dead will rise.

No class has less class than this class

Power can not be taken alone.

Love Can Take Your Breath Away.

The classic love story by William Shakespeare.

In America’s forgotten war, they made history.

The Devil's Playground is Just Around The Corner

He lives! They die! Christopher Lee as the fanged undead.

The fury of Zoroark has been unleashed!

It'll make you laugh...'til you cry.

19318: A few days in the life of a Czechoslovak teenager when he starts work.

The Woman He's About to Touch is a Dream. The Murder He's About to Commit is Not.

The Racket boldly begins where the Senate crime committee left off!

From the silk sheets... to the mean streets...

Once you see them nothing can save you.

Will you cross the skies for me?
25974: Jean, a PE teacher, is forced to live a double life. When a new student arrives and threatens to expose her sexuality, Jean is pushed to extreme lengths to keep her job and her integrity.

NBA superstar Kevin Durant has got game. His biggest fan has none. Things are about to switch!

Fame is desire, love is a curse.

The Pranks Just Got a Whole Lot Bigger... We Measured.

Sometimes revenge is the only solution.

It AIN'T all good in da hood.

Driss, captain of the narcotics squad
30838: Beauty Blogger Alexa Landry only had one fear, plastic surgery. She ultimately had to face this fear when she was kidnapped with her friends by Dr. Cunningham. A deranged plastic surgeon who is obsessed with beautifying his victims.

The Truth, The Whole Truth and Nothing but the F**king Truth!
32118: Seven strangers find themselves unwitting participants in a U.S. government evacuation program gone horribly wrong.
